timeline.summary: 27 Apr 2026: Monarch Networth said its maiden PMS, the Monarch Wealth Creator Fund, raised ₹100 Cr entirely through its own network and set a ₹500 Cr AUM target for the next two months.
Ashok Daulatraj Bafna, Promoter and Executive Director, disclosed no new encumbrances on Monarch Networth Capital shares as of April 6, 2026, beyond prior disclosures.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹99.87 Cr (+63.8% YoY), net profit ₹45.56 Cr (+84.4% YoY).
Monarch Networth Capital incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, Monarch Capital Venture Private Limited, on May 13, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹123.14 Cr (+48.1% YoY), net profit ₹56.56 Cr (+25.8% YoY).
Board approved 1:5 stock split from ₹10 to ₹2 face value, subject to shareholder approval
